title: Ubutungane mu Bacuruzi .
intro: Igishushanyo cari gihagaze imbere y’abantu bari bariwe n’uruyeri rw’inyungu, kikabahamagara ngo babe inzirabugunge n’ubutungane mu migenderanire yabo. Uwo musavyi wa Allah yaragabishije ku bijanye no gutanga ingero ngufi no guhindura umunzane. Abantu banse kwumviriza, batera ubwoba ko bazokwirukana uwo muntu mu gihugu cabo. Isi ubwayo yohagurutse mu kubacira urubanza. None uwo muntu yahagarariye ubutungane mu badandaza ni nde?
clues: Narungitswe nk’intumwa ku bantu bari binjiye cane mu vy’ubudandaji n’ubudandaji.
Abantu banje baratanga ingero ngufi igihe bapima ibintu vy’abandi.
Baca batera ubwoba ko bazonyirukana mu gihugu nimbandanya kubahamagara mu kwizera.
Ndibuka ko ndi umuvugizi w’umunyabwenge kuruta abandi bose mu bahanuzi.
Abantu banje barafashwe n’umutingito w’ubukazi ubasiga ata buzima mu mazu yabo.
Narungitswe ku bantu b’i Madyan mu buraruko bwa Hijaz.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Bateye ubwoba ko bazokwirukanwa mu gihugu .
Baterewe mu muriro ururumba n'abantu banje .
Yarahanganye n’ivyo gushaka guhingura ingamiya y’ingore ivuye mu rutare
Nabonye ukuntu igisagara canje casambuwe n’ingabo z’abamarayika .
trial.answer: Bateye ubwoba ko bazokwirukanwa mu gihugu .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Abantu banje baratatanijwe n’umuyaga uvuza induru .
Narakijijwe ndi mu nda y'ifi nini .

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
